strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: Fig. 5.6 'Flows for Manganese, pure metal, at regional storage'. The text says the functional unit of the process is one tonne of manganese consumed in Europe, but the figure caption states explicitly 'Values correspond to the functional unit of 1 kg manganese metal', so the basis is 1 kg.; allocation: none stated; an electrothermal/electrolysis production split of 75/25 is assumed, and 75 % of the Mn in the electrothermal raw material is taken from ore, the rest from burden-free slag.. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

gaps_reported_by_model: No process-specific emissions at all: 'The process specific emissions could be considerable but due to lack of data none are considered.'
No chemicals for reduction and leaching in the electrolytic route - 'Considerable amounts of chemicals ought to be used ... but no detailed information is available.'
No transport is inventoried in this module at all; the report admits this is 'obviously not correct'.
No refining step after the electrothermal reduction.
The report states the overall quality of this module is poor and it should only be used where manganese plays a minor role.
skipped_items: manganese, at regional storage: product — reference product, global average
high silica slag: ignore — the table marks this line 'not inventoried' - the slag fraction of the electrothermal raw material is treated as burden free.
